name: 合成波
description: 深蓝紫阴影与高饱和霓虹轮廓对比，线框节奏带来鲜明电子速度感。
rendering_prompt: Use the high-contrast electronic imagery of the 1980s, anchoring shadows in deep blue and purple while magenta, electric cyan, and orange-pink gradients create vivid highlights. Make contours streamlined and sharp with restrained neon glow. Distill existing structures into precise wireframes and grid rhythms where appropriate. Keep light-dark divisions crisp and colors intense, suggesting the regular pulse and speed of electronic music rather than diffuse, faded color.
avoid: 褪色低反差、强制添加汽车或落日
difference: 合成波是高反差电子图形；蒸汽波是柔淡数码怀旧
tuning: 沿已有结构建立线框节奏，避免新增与主题无关的网格地平线。
